_comment: Hand-curated versification corrections the auto-generator (scripts/build_versification_map.py) cannot derive, merged OVER the auto map at load time. Two reasons: (1) ru_synodal IS the Russian anchor, yet its data merges the superscription / short verses in 12 titled psalms, so some curated (English/Masoretic-numbered) refs land a verse or more off — the generator never corrects its own anchor. (2) Because ru_nrt was auto-aligned TO that shifted anchor, its entries for the same psalms inherited the shift and are corrected here too. All verified by hand (bilingual EN<->RU). NOTE: ps 32:8 and ps 91:2 are simply ABSENT from ru_synodal source data (Greek verses 31:8-9 and 90:2 are missing) and cannot be mapped.
